_authority: docs/PARAMETERS.md §1 — every constant carries a rationale; change a constant → rerun the smokes → commit both (family rule).

nuclear.rationale: PARAMETERS §1.1 large PWR: H 6 s (big rotor), 8 s reheat lag = why steam cannot arrest a fast dip; FCR band ±2% P_n (French practice; game default participation OFF); xenon lockout 48 h after a trip.

coal.rationale: PARAMETERS §1.2 supercritical hard coal: classic sluggish reheat (T_RH 10 s, F_HP 0.30); boiler-storage limits folded into the ±5% FCR band + 3%/min ramp.

lignite.rationale: PARAMETERS §1.3: as coal but stiffer (P_min 40%, 2%/min) — mine-mouth baseload character.

gas_ccgt.rationale: PARAMETERS §1.4 H-class single shaft: GT delivers 2/3 fast (~1-2 s), the HRSG steam tail (1/3) breathes over 2 min — 'fast, then breathes'.

gas_ocgt.rationale: PARAMETERS §1.5: the fastest thermal responder (GAST T1 0.3/T2 0.8, ±10% FCR band, 15%/min, 15-min start any state); expensive fuel is the game-side counterweight.

hydro_ps.rationale: PARAMETERS §1.10: transient-droop governor (T_r 6 s, r_t 0.4 → 60 s sustained lag) + non-minimum-phase water column (T_w 1.5 s) — the wrong-way kick is real physics the player sees; 30-100% generating range, 2-min start.
hydro_ps._reservoir_rationale: PARAMETERS 1.10: 300 MW / 8 h = 2400 MWh reference; pump/turbine efficiencies give the ~0.79 round trip; pumping is a motor load that keeps the machine's inertia in the pool (P8 pump mode)

wind_onshore.rationale: PARAMETERS §1.7: converter-coupled, H = 0; pitch-limited upward (2 s), fast curtail down (0.2 s); mandatory LFSM-O above 50.2 Hz at 5% droop (RfG).
wind_onshore._avail_slew_rationale: synoptic/frontal wind changes move a whole park's output over ~5 min, not in one instant — smooths the 15-min wire sample-and-hold into the ramp the atmosphere actually delivers

wind_offshore.rationale: PARAMETERS §1.8: as onshore; the far-shore/hub connection story is GAME_DESIGN §1.4 + PARAMETERS §1.16.
wind_offshore._avail_slew_rationale: as onshore: a front crosses a 500 MW park in minutes

solar_pv.rationale: PARAMETERS §1.9: effectively instant converter (0.1 s), zero inertia — the midday displacement of synchronous units is the campaign's core tension.
solar_pv._avail_slew_rationale: cloud edges sweep a 150 MW park in ~2.5 min at the fastest

battery.rationale: PARAMETERS §1.11 grid-following BESS: full FFR at ±200 mHz through a 0.1 s converter lag — arrests the dip steam physically cannot, but contributes NO inertia (RoCoF unchanged: the core lesson); round trip 88.4%.

battery_gfm.rationale: PARAMETERS §1.12 grid-forming VSM: virtual H_v 4 s COUNTS INTO the island inertia pool (the only converter that lowers RoCoF); 2% droop with no deadband (gain P_n/Hz = full at 1 Hz), 0.05 s lag; inertial energy debits SoC.

electrolyzer.rationale: PARAMETERS §1.13 PEM: controllable load providing upward reserve BY SHEDDING — full shed at −200 mHz through a 0.3 s lag (the inverted lesson); 49.6 Hz auto-shed tier arrives with protection (P8).

frequency_protection.rationale: PARAMETERS §2.2: synchronous machines trip outside [47.5, 51.5] Hz after 100 ms; converters ride through inside the same window (RfG) — LFSM-O handles the 50.2-51.5 band without disconnection cliffs.

_afrr_rationale: PARAMETERS §2.1 aFRR layer: the contracted secondary band as a fraction of P_n, and the default AGC participation weight (ledger 19). Nuclear 0 by default — must-run identity, ledger 9; hydro/OCGT lead because their ramps deliver within the 15-min restoration window.
